name: Hearthstone-Deck-Tracker
description_en: A deck tracker and deck manager for Hearthstone on Windows
readme_excerpt: Hearthstone-Deck-Tracker Hearthstone Deck Tracker is an automatic deck tracker and deck manager for Hearthstone. Installation - Requirements: - Windows Vista or higher - .NET Framework 4.5 or higher - Download and run the installer. Community & Troubleshooting - Follow HDT on X - Join the Community Discord: - You can find the FAQ here. - Streamers: Please read Streaming instructions for OBS and XSplit and Twitch extension setup. - HSReplay.net integration: Please email for support.
